title: Understanding Exponential Regularization
text: Think about how the exponential function behaves for positive and negative values. How does this affect the penalty applied to coefficients in comparison to L1 and L2 regularization?

title: Comparing Penalties
text: Consider the nature of the exponential function. It grows rapidly for positive values and approaches zero for negative values. How might this influence the penalty on large positive and negative coefficients?

title: Evaluating Large Positive Coefficients
text: Which regularization method is likely to impose a greater penalty on large positive coefficients?

title: Evaluating Large Negative Coefficients
text: Does exponential regularization impose a greater penalty on large negative coefficients compared to L2 regularization?

title: Feature Selection with Regularization
text: L1 regularization is known for its ability to perform feature selection by setting some coefficients to zero. Consider how exponential regularization might differ in this aspect.
